Regions with x0 > -2.06 in > 50% of starts: Left-F2-rostral (7, 92%), Right-ACC (108, 88%), Left-STS-anterior (40, 88%), Right-OFC (82, 75%), Right-Gyrus-rectus (83, 75%), Left-OFC (1, 79%), Left-ACC (27, 79%). Rank 1 across starts: 82 in 50%, 7 in 12.5%. But 'seizing' (max x > -1 within the window) is 0 for every region in 23/24 starts: amp ~3.4 (prior median 0.015) - the fit explains the features with sub-threshold x excursions times a large gain scale.

predictive_checks: not_performed for the MAP bundle (no held-out presurgical seizure exists for P2; posterior predictive residual checks planned in the NUTS bundle)
intended_use: intervention simulation input; not qualified. PRELIMINARY: lets R4 set up and test intervention simulations before the final NUTS bundle; predictions must not be frozen on this bundle. Research on a virtual patient; not a clinical prediction; a fitted estimate is not a calibrated probability.
limitations: Model qualification pending (T0011 benchmark running); per A0015 P2 results are 'not qualified' unless R5 passes the benchmark.

Primary window violates the observation model's rest-at-first-observation assumption: 177/191 channels have their feature maximum at the first post-stimulation observation (power decays after the stim train). The frozen model then finds no supra-threshold node (H4-like) - this may be a model/data mismatch rather than evidence against an EZ.

Short windows: 8 (post) / 15 (full) observations at ~2 Hz = 1.6 / 2.8 model time units (frozen dt*nsub = 0.2 per obs), too short for sub-critical-to-seizure transitions of the 2D Epileptor; regions with x0 > -2.06 mostly do not seize within the window.
Sensitivity window includes stimulation-driven activity that the 2D model (no stimulus input) can only attribute to regions; EZ estimates there may track the stimulated tissue.
Region 82 (Right-OFC) carries the implant's largest gain (R7-8 88.2); its top x0 rank may reflect gain leverage.
Generator/inverter mismatch (6D+m SpatEpiStim vs 2D Epileptor), noise-free data with float-round-off tails, frozen baseline rule unsatisfiable on P2.
for_R4: Each CSV row is one model sample (x0, z_init, K, tau0 with frozen constants I1=3.1, dt=0.1, nsub=2, P2 SC). The primary (post) ensemble has no supra-threshold region, so its baseline simulations inside the fitted horizon show no seizure; the sensitivity (full) ensemble has supra-threshold regions. Which ensemble to simulate is a LEAD/R4 decision; both are not qualified.
